تمنطقت (form IIq)
# تَمَنْطَقْتُ (tamanṭaqtu) /ta.man.tˤaq.tu/: first-person singular past active of تَمَنْطَقَ (tamanṭaqa)
# تَمَنْطَقْتَ (tamanṭaqta) /ta.man.tˤaq.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of تَمَنْطَقَ (tamanṭaqa)
# تَمَنْطَقْتِ (tamanṭaqti) /ta.man.tˤaq.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of تَمَنْطَقَ (tamanṭaqa)
# تَمَنْطَقَتْ (tamanṭaqat) /ta.man.tˤa.qat
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
